description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed at the start of any round, including the first.

name: Spawn
description: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Units placed via Spawn can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

name: Split
description: When this unit is fully destroyed, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it before removing the last model. Units placed via Split can't seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

name: Reanimation
description: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, roll as many dice as the max. number of models/wounds it could restore. For each 5+ you may restore one model/wound. Note that new models may only be restored if they can be placed in coherency with non-restored models.

name: Reanimation Aura
description: This model and its unit get Reanimation.

name: Reinforcement
description: When a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken, you may remove it from the table as destroyed. At the beginning of the next round after a unit where all models have this rule is destroyed, after Ambushers have been deployed, you may place a new copy of it fully within 9" of any table edge, over 9" away from enemy units. Units that deploy via Reinforcement can't seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy, and this rule doesn't apply to the new copy of the unit.

name: Ambush Re-Deployment
description: Once per game, when a unit where all models have this rule ends its activation, you may immediately remove it from the table (dropping any objectives it might hold within 1"), and deploy it as if it had Ambush at the beginning of the next round.

name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

name: Dash
description: Once per round, at the end of this unit's activation, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

name: Dash Aura
description: This model and its unit get Dash.

name: Mind Control
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Units may only be moved once per round in this way.

name: Fatigue Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it becomes Fatigued.

name: Spell Drain
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which must take a Morale Test. If failed, it loses 2 spell tokens.

name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff Effect
description: This unit counts as being in Dangerous Terrain on its next move - it rolls a die per wound it would take to destroy it, taking a wound on each 1.

name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff (Immediate)
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18", which must immediately take a Dangerous Terrain test - it rolls a die per wound it would take to destroy it, taking a wound on each 1.

name: Difficult Terrain Debuff Effect
description: This unit counts as being in Difficult Terrain on its next move - that move is capped at 6".

name: Difficult Terrain Debuff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Difficult terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Quick Shot
description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

name: Quick Shot Aura
description: This model and its unit get Quick Shot.

name: Quick Shot Mark
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight. One friendly unit that used a Rush action may still shoot it once.

name: Unwieldy in melee
description: Strikes last when charging - the charged unit swings first.

name: Unwieldy on its weapons in melee
description: Gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee: strikes last when charging.

name: Unstoppable on their weapons when shooting
description: Gets Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting.

name: Shred on its weapons when shooting
description: Gets Shred on its weapons when shooting.

name: AP(1) on their weapons when shooting
description: Gets AP(1) on its weapons when shooting.

name: Indirect on their weapons
description: Gets Indirect on its weapons.

name: Rending on their weapons in melee
description: Gets Rending on its weapons in melee.

name: +6" range on its weapons when shooting
description: Gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

name: +6" range on their weapons when shooting
description: Gets +6" range on its weapons when shooting.

name: Bane on their weapons when attacking
description: Gets Bane on its weapons when attacking.

name: Shred on its weapons in melee
description: Gets Shred on its weapons in melee.

name: Shred on their weapons when attacking
description: Gets Shred on its weapons when attacking.

name: Unwieldy Debuff

effect.ruleName: Unwieldy on its weapons in melee

description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

name: No Retreat
description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

name: No Retreat Aura
description: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

name: No Retreat Buff
description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets No Retreat once (next time the effect would apply).

name: Inquisitorial Agent
description: Once per game, if all models in this unit have this rule, it may be activated even if it had already activated this round (stops being Fatigued when activated again). Only up to one third of the units in the army with this rule at the beginning of the game (rounding up) may use it in a single round.

name: Takedown Strike
description: Once per game, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, it may make X attacks at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

name: Takedown Shot
description: Once per game, when this model shoots, it may make X extra attacks against the target at Quality 2+ with AP(2), Deadly(3), and Takedown.

name: Coordinate
description: At the end of this unit's activation, another friendly unit within 12" that hasn't activated yet may be activated immediately. May not be used if this unit was activated via Coordinate.

name: Surprise Attack
description: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight and roll X dice; for each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

name: Instinctive
description: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

name: Vengeance
description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

name: Regenerative Strength
description: Place one token on this model when it ignores a wound. Once per round, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, roll as many dice as tokens on it before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 4+ the target takes one wound.

name: Ravage Aura
description: This model and its unit get Ravage(+1).

name: Ravage (Aura)
description: Ravage(+1) from Ravage Aura: once per round, when it's this model's turn to strike in melee, roll 1 more die before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

name: Anti-Cover
description: This weapon ignores Cover.

name: Anti-Cover when Shooting
description: This model gets Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

name: Anti-Cover Aura
description: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

name: Anti-Cover when Shooting Aura
description: This model and its unit get Anti-Cover on its weapons when shooting.

name: Anti-Regen
description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

name: Smash
description: When attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

name: Pierce
description: Ignores all positive Defense modifiers on the target, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

name: Fracture
description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

name: Fragment
description: When attacking units where most models have Defense 5+ to Defense 6+, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

name: Puncture
description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

name: Obliterate
description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

name: Decimate
description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

name: Demolish
description: Ignores Cover, and when attacking units with most models within 1" of terrain, this weapon gets AP(+1).

name: Purge
description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, this weapon gets AP(+2).

name: Reap
description: When attacking units that are Shaken or Fatigued, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 5-6.

name: Scourge
description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

name: Unwieldy
description: Strikes last when charging.

name: Imprecise
description: Gets -1 to hit when attacking.

name: Crossing Strike
description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

name: Darkborn
description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

name: Shadowborn
description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".

name: Shrouded
description: When a unit where most models have this rule is targeted by an enemy unit for shooting/charging, that enemy unit gets -4"/-2" range to a min. of 6".
